context.zh: 记录墨水打印的流畅性、颜色、干燥及牢度测试结果。
context.en: Record ink-printing tests for flow, colour, drying and fastness.

task.zh: 把测试观察记成可比记录

deliverable.zh: 带测试条件和各项结果的打印测试记录表
deliverable.en: A printing-test record with conditions and results

reading.zh: 数据来自打印测试，需要把流畅性、颜色、干燥和牢度的结果与测试条件对应起来，便于比较。
reading.en: The data come from printing tests. Flow, colour, drying and fastness results need to be recorded alongside test conditions so they can be compared.

context.zh: 统计招聘数据、复盘流程，改进招聘效率和候选人体验。
context.en: Review recruitment data to improve hiring efficiency and candidate experience.

task.zh: 找出招聘流程卡在哪里

deliverable.zh: 分环节招聘看板与流程改进建议
deliverable.en: A stage-by-stage hiring view and process recommendations

reading.zh: 招聘数据要连回筛选、面试和入职步骤，解释效率与候选人体验出了什么问题。
reading.en: Recruitment data link back to screening, interviews and onboarding to explain problems with speed or candidate experience.
